title: Beyond Hormuz: Africa’s Refining Revival
text:
Webinar

Beyond Hormuz: Africa’s Refining Revival

Register Now

15 October 2026 – 11.00am SAST

online

The closure of the Strait of Hormuz has underscored a long-standing paradox: Africa produces oil, yet many of its economies depend heavily on imported fuel.

With new refineries in the pipeline and dormant capacity being revived, the continent is increasingly looking to process its own crude oil, turning crisis into opportunity.

Join us as we explore Africa’s refining renaissance.

This webinar is being held on our new platform, ON24. If you do not receive your confirmation email, please check your junk and spam folders.
